title: A programmatic fallback participates in single-bean selection
summary: A programmatically registered fallback now loses single-bean selection to the regular bean. The provider stream retained both singleton identities in either registration order.

change.description: Passing Fallback.class as a qualifier to AnnotatedBeanDefinitionReader.registerBean now marks the resulting bean definition as a fallback candidate.

notes: The same programmatic overload with Primary selected the reserve bean on both revisions.
